ground_truth_root_cause: Commit 2b9113d98e20 modified helm/payment-service/values.production.yaml and accidentally set circuitBreaker.errorRateThreshold to 0.001 (0.1%) instead of the correct value of 0.50 (50%). This extremely low threshold causes the circuit breaker to trip after just one transient upstream error once the volumeThreshold of 5 requests is reached. Because 0.001 is far below any realistic steady-state error rate, every HALF_OPEN recovery probe that encounters a single failure immediately re-trips the breaker, making automatic recovery impossible and resulting in 100% of payment requests being rejected.
ground_truth_remediation: 1. Edit helm/payment-service/values.production.yaml and restore circuitBreaker.errorRateThreshold from 0.001 to 0.50. 2. Apply the corrected Helm values: helm upgrade payment-service ./helm/payment-service -f helm/payment-service/values.production.yaml. 3. Perform a rolling restart: kubectl rollout restart deployment/payment-service. 4. Verify in pod logs that circuit breaker initializes with threshold=0.50 and confirm payment requests succeed end-to-end. 5. Add a Helm values validation policy (OPA/Conftest) asserting circuitBreaker.errorRateThreshold >= 0.05 to prevent recurrence.
